jerelin_0.m: I dislike being disturbed. I disliked it when I was alive, and I dislike it even more now!

jerelin_1.m:
Hmpff. Go away! 

[You take the rather dull looking oegyth crystal.]

laeroth_caretaker.10: I met a caretaker at Laeroth manor. He said he cannot leave because he is bound by an oath, but not one he ever gave.
laeroth_caretaker.15: The caretaker said that he feels honor bound by a pledge that his great-great grandfather made many years ago.
laeroth_caretaker.17: Moriath told me only the past lords can release him from the oath, but they are dead. He suggested I look in the library for information about how to talk to them.
laeroth_caretaker.20: I have learned the chant needed to send spirits back to their rest on the other side.
laeroth_caretaker.30: I have learned how to raise the spirits of the dead with the help of an oegyth crystal. But I also need a personal item. I should talk to Moriath again.
laeroth_caretaker.35: Moriath suggested I search the master bedroom for a personal item from the last lord, Verigil.
laeroth_caretaker.40: Verigil told me he could not release the Caretaker from his oath, because he is from the wrong branch of the family. I must talk to his uncle, Eyvipa. He has gone back to his rest.
laeroth_caretaker.50: Moriath suggested I look for an item with "E" engraved on it. This would have belonged to Eyvipa.
laeroth_caretaker.60: I have found an expensive looking candlestick with "E" engraved on it. This must have belonged to Eyvipa.
laeroth_caretaker.70: Eyvipa was angry that I woke him from his rest. He refused to help me because his father passed him over, and made his younger brother, Cuned, lord. I had to send him back to his rest with the chant "estray inyay eacepay".
laeroth_caretaker.80: I found a diary that must have belonged to Cuned.
laeroth_caretaker.90: Cuned told me that Verigil is correct, and he cannot release the caretaker from his oath because he is from the wrong branch of the family. I must talk to his father, Jerelin.
laeroth_caretaker.100: After much searching I found a seal for Jerelin in an old chest. I must go back to the tomb again.
laeroth_caretaker.110: Jerelin ignored me, and went back to his resting place. I will have to ask Cuned again what to do.
laeroth_caretaker.120: Cuned told me to speak to his mother, Audela. Jerelin didn't listen to many people, but he listened to her.
laeroth_caretaker.130: I have found what appears to be a jewelry box, with "A" inscribed on it. It is locked though, and too heavy to move to the tomb.
laeroth_caretaker.140: I have found a key in the bedroom.
laeroth_caretaker.150: The key fitted the jewelry box! Inside I found a necklace "With love to Audela" written on the back.
laeroth_caretaker.160: Audela told me to talk to Jerelin again, but tell him Audela wants this done.
laeroth_caretaker.170: I spoke to Jerelin again, and told him of Audela's wishes. He told me he will release the caretaker, but with a condition. The caretakers last act must be to move his grave away from that of his nagging wife.
laeroth_caretaker.180: I told the caretaker what he has to do to be released from the oath. He thanked me, and agreed to do it.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
